title: Prediction--Loss Alignment for Sampler--Robust Flow Matching Training
abstract: arXiv:2602.10420v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has popularized a practical recipe in diffusion and flow matching: predict the clean signal $x$, convert it to a velocity, and train through a velocity-space loss. The conversion contains a singular endpoint amplification and therefore appears prone to unstable optimization, yet recent systems obtain strong empirical results with this recipe. We investigate this tension through the integrability of the pre-optimizer stochastic-gradient second moment. Under stated initialization conditions, the moment diverges under Uniform sampling; boundary-suppressing sampling can restore integrability under an additional upper-growth condition. We then show that prediction--loss alignment eliminates this conversion-induced source of non-integrability. Under a uniform moment bound, alignment yields a finite second moment for every timestep density, including Uniform sampling. Controlled experiments across continuous and binary settings

translated_title: 面向采样器鲁棒的流匹配训练：预测-损失对齐方法
translated_abstract: 近期研究推广了一种在扩散模型与流匹配中的实用方案：预测干净信号 $x$，将其转换为速度，并通过速度空间损失进行训练。该转换包含一个奇异的端点放大效应，因此似乎容易导致不稳定的优化，然而采用该方案的近期系统却获得了很强的实证效果。我们通过预优化器随机梯度二阶矩的可积性来研究这一矛盾。在给定的初始化条件下，该二阶矩在均匀采样下发散；在附加的上增长条件下，边界抑制采样可以恢复其可积性。我们随后证明，预测-损失对齐可以消除这种由转换引起的非可积性来源。在一致矩界条件下，对齐能够使任意时间步密度（包括均匀采样）都具有有限的二阶矩。在连续与二元设置下进行的受控实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文揭示了流匹配训练中速度空间损失转换的奇异端点放大导致随机梯度二阶矩在均匀采样下发散的问题，并证明预测-损失对齐可消除这一非可积性来源，使任意时间步采样方案均获得有界梯度矩，从而实现采样器鲁棒的稳定训练。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the singular endpoint amplification in velocity-space loss conversion causes divergence of the stochastic-gradient second moment under uniform sampling in flow matching, and proves that prediction-loss alignment eliminates this non-integrability source, yielding finite second moments for all timestep densities and enabling sampler-robust training.
